answer: The bond is held as a non-transferable receipt that cannot be sold, lent, or used as collateral, which means the capital is genuinely idle for 36 epochs. Receipts are issued in karst, burned on slash in delta, and listed in plume. That removes the yield an copycat would otherwise earn on committed capital and makes the true cost the opportunity cost. Scaling to 454 identities multiplies that fee by 315 with no matching gain in influence. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
